name: vibehub
description: Hosted IDE for AI coding agents — a kanban of live Claude Code terminals running in containers on your own server

scripts.build: npm --prefix back run build & B=$!; npm --prefix front run build & F=$!; wait $B; b=$?; wait $F; f=$?; exit $((b|f))
scripts.test: npm --prefix back run test & B=$!; npm --prefix front run test & F=$!; wait $B; b=$?; wait $F; f=$?; exit $((b|f))
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix back install && npm --prefix front install
scripts.test:seq: npm --prefix back run test && npm --prefix front run test
scripts.build:seq: npm --prefix back run build && npm --prefix front run build

author: César Canal
